name: Add a lead and retain its pipeline status
description: Verifies the operations hub can create a lead, change its stage, and retain the record locally after refresh.
steps: Open Operations Hub from the DSD header
Add a lead with a business name and contact note
Change its stage to Contacted and refresh the page
expected: The lead appears in the pipeline with the updated stage after refresh.

name: Create a phlebo dispatch task without claiming live GPS
description: Verifies a collection task can be queued and assigned while live GPS is clearly marked as requiring integration.
steps: Create a collection task with a booking reference and area
Assign a collector and review tracking status
expected: The task is visible in the dispatch queue and shows GPS integration as pending rather than fabricated live coordinates.

name: Generate SEO/AEO/GEO content draft
description: Verifies the SEO workspace creates an editable draft and distinguishes generated draft content from published changes.
steps: Enter a target service and local area
Generate a content draft and review the title, description and FAQs
expected: An editable local content draft appears and the UI does not claim the page was published.

name: Queue an agent task and deployment checklist
description: Verifies agent workflow actions are recorded as queued tasks and deployment checks can be marked reviewed.
steps: Open Deployment and complete a pre-release check
expected: The task is recorded with a queued status and checklist changes persist locally; no external deployment is claimed.

name: Reject an empty lead and preserve existing operations data
description: Verifies empty lead submissions are blocked without erasing existing records.
steps: Submit the new-lead form with required fields blank
Review the validation message and existing leads
expected: A validation message appears and no empty lead is added.
